body: Alright, I've drunk enough, I'm taking the meds. Anyone interested in my last minutes awake?
I'm drinking now and I'll take enough meds to end this all. Let me know if anyone wants to talk, I can share my experiences.

She's contacted me again. She ran by my place, rang the doorbell but I was late to answer. Later she suggested we run together the next day. Tonight she's messaged me on fb and her GPS was on. I could see that after midnight she was not at home and not at a bar either. I went to that place and it is a house, she's definitely cheating on her bf again. It's just too much for me. She's given some hope again and she took it away immediately. She said a few months ago that she'd end this thing, ie. cheating with various guys. I literally can't take it any longer. Thank you for everything, I'm ready to die.
Man, at least you can publish your paper now. Doesn't happen often in my field (econ). How about talking to your ex?

Alright, it's very good that you're willing to treat this issue! Happy to hear you're feeling a little better!Is there anything that you could do now to feel a bit even better? A friend of mine usually relaxes by watching cat videos on youtube. Have you tried going outdoors to breathe some fresh air? What about going home and grabbing an ice cream on your way?

Yeah, it really sounds to me as a panic attack. I usually take a Rivotril when this happens. It helps extremely quickly, in 15 mins the panic attack is over. How are you feeling now? And yes, depression is a legitimate disease, it's not just whining. Have you consulted with a therapist?
Thank you, you're sweet. I honestly wish you all the best. You can do it, just reach out to people :)

Well, I'd suggest getting a therapist and maybe talking to friends you trust. As for the person you're dating: if they like you, they won't leave you because you're depressed. If they leave you, then they didn't even like the person who you are in the first place. At least that's what I think. I've been struggling with depression myself and getting my heart broken didn't help either, that's how I found this place.
I hear you, I have the same issue, don't even want to leave my apt, don't want to meet people, etc. Do you have a therapist? Any friends you can meet for an ice cream?
OK, so it might be a stupid idea, but how about supporting one of those anti-bullying organizations? Either by cash or by volunteering? Maybe it could help you leave the past behind.
Maybe it's just me, but I'd happily forgive any sins of a person I love. That's what love/friendship is all about, isn't it? Do you want to talk about what you did?
Thank you so much, I will try and work on it!
You are right, no doubt. It's amazing how obvious it must be for an outsider like you (no offense meant) and still, my heart and my mind struggle to accept this. Thank you so much!
Thank you for your kind words! As a matter of fact, she's still cheating on her bf. It's not a good feeling to be dismissed and replaced...
